cues.en: Hello and welcome to this section on responsible AI.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎來到負責任 AI 章節。

cues.en: Now, this might not be the most exciting section, but it is important and there can, and probably will be questions about this on the exam.
cues.zh: 也許不是最刺激，但很重要，考試可能、而且很可能會問。

cues.en: So we'll go through it, and aim to make it as fun as possible as we go through these tutorials.
cues.zh: 一起看，盡量讓教學有趣。

cues.en: The first one is features of responsible AI.
cues.zh: 第一堂，負責任 AI 的特性。

cues.en: So you need to know the following features for the exam for responsible AI.
cues.zh: 考試要知道以下特性。

cues.en: And in this box, we're gonna talk about the features.
cues.zh: 這個框會談它們。

cues.en: Now, we're gonna cover six.
cues.zh: 介紹六個。

cues.en: In reality, that number might change, it might change on the website, so reference the AWS website, and also you'll see that they overlap.
cues.zh: 實際數量、網站可能改變，請參考 AWS 網站，也會發現概念重疊。

cues.en: Ultimately, it's just important to understand the different concepts behind them.
cues.zh: 最重要理解背後概念。

cues.en: It doesn't really matter the exact term that is used for title, that's used for each feature.
cues.zh: 每項確切標題用詞沒那麼重要。

cues.en: So first one is fairness.
cues.zh: 第一，公平性。

cues.en: Obviously, AI systems need to treat all people equally and fairly, regardless of gender, race, background, ethnicity and things like that.
cues.zh: AI 應平等、公平對待所有人，不論性別、種族、背景、族裔等。

cues.en: So that's a very important consideration that has to be embedded in AI, and that's a consideration for responsible AI.
cues.zh: 應納入 AI 設計，是負責任 AI 的重要考量。

cues.en: Next one is explainability, and that is the ability to explain what happens inside AI systems.
cues.zh: 接著可解釋性，能說明 AI 內部發生什麼。

cues.en: Why did they make the decisions that they make?
cues.zh: 為何做這個決定？

cues.en: Why was somebody denied a credit score?
cues.zh: 為何某人被拒絕信用評估？

cues.en: Why would somebody else approve the credit score?
cues.zh: 為何另一人獲准？

cues.en: And things like that.
cues.zh: 等等。

cues.en: So we'll have a tutorial separately about explainability.
cues.zh: 會另有可解釋性教學。

cues.en: If it's not possible to completely explain an AI, some of them are like black boxes because of all the neural networks involved, at least it needs to be as interpretable as possible.
cues.zh: 有些神經網路像黑箱，無法完全解釋時，至少盡可能可解讀。

cues.en: We'll talk about separately about explainability and interpretability, but if there's no explainability, at least it needs to be interpretable.
cues.zh: 會另談可解釋性與可解讀性，不能解釋，至少要能解讀。

cues.en: Why?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: Like at least we need to aim for interpretability to understand why certain things happen a certain way.
cues.zh: 至少以可解讀為目標，理解事情為何如此。

cues.en: Another one is privacy and security, and that's basically ensuring that user data is, they have control over their data
cues.zh: 隱私與安全，確保使用者能控制資料，

cues.en: and they can delete it if they may wish not to, their data to be exposed.
cues.zh: 不想暴露時可刪除。

cues.en: And also it's securely stored, protected from attackers and things like that.
cues.zh: 也安全儲存、防攻擊等。

cues.en: Robustness, you want to make sure that your AI system is reliable and that the way it's designed to work and the way you've tested it in a training environment, when you deploy it to the real world,
cues.zh: 穩健性，確保可靠，訓練環境設計與測試的系統，部署真實世界時，

cues.en: it is actually going to work the way it was designed to work.
cues.zh: 確實按照設計運作。

cues.en: So that's robustness, a very important feature, and that you can be confident that the AI system is working as intended.
cues.zh: 這是穩健性，重要特性，讓人有信心系統如預期。

cues.en: Governance, and that's the practice of businesses, enterprises putting in frameworks and rules around AI,
cues.zh: 治理，企業設 AI 框架與規則，

cues.en: of how they use AI, how they don't use AI, what they communicate internally and things like that.
cues.zh: 如何用、不用、內部如何溝通等等。

cues.en: So basically strict procedures around the use of AI.
cues.zh: 基本上是嚴謹的 AI 使用程序。

cues.en: And transparency, what AWS is referring to here is you being open with the users that interact with your company or your business
cues.zh: 透明度，AWS 這裡指對與企業互動的使用者，

cues.en: or your customers, your patients, your clients, you being open with them when they're interacting with AI, when they are not just interacting with AI,
cues.zh: 顧客、病患、客戶坦誠，讓他們知道何時正與 AI 互動，不只直接互動，

cues.en: but when AI is being involved in the processing of their information, or being involved in somehow in their interaction
cues.zh: 也包括 AI 參與資料處理，或參與他們和企業的

cues.en: with your business.
cues.zh: 任何互動。

cues.en: So that's being transparent about the usage of AI.
cues.zh: 對使用 AI 保持透明。

cues.en: So there we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: Those are the six main things.
cues.zh: 六個主要項目。

cues.en: Again, the number might be slightly different, the titles might be different, but those are the main core concepts that AWS expects you to know about responsible AI, and these can and probably will come up on the exam.
cues.zh: 數量、標題可能不同，但這些是 AWS 期待理解的核心，考試可能而且很可能出現。

cues.en: Here's a quick summary of what we discussed.
cues.zh: 快速整理。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you back here in next 10 minutes.
cues.zh: 期待接下來十分鐘內再見。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy the cloud.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受雲端的樂趣吧。
